problem_summary: A finite sum is proved by expressing each summand as a consecutive difference.
proof_summary: Establish the local difference identity and telescope, checking both boundary terms.
transferable_lemmas: Consecutive differences telescope once the local identity is proved.
non_transferable_conditions: The target local identity and index boundaries require independent proof.
transfer_risks: A shifted index can leave an uncancelled boundary term.
required_bridge_lemmas: Prove the target term is the required consecutive difference.

problem_summary: A finite combinatorial configuration is controlled by choosing a minimal counterexample and applying a descent move.
proof_summary: Define a well-founded size, prove every forbidden configuration admits a strictly smaller one, and discharge the minimal boundary.
transferable_lemmas: A strictly decreasing nonnegative integer measure rules out an infinite descent.
non_transferable_conditions: The target reduction must preserve all hypotheses.
transfer_risks: The proposed measure may fail to decrease on an exceptional move.
required_bridge_lemmas: Verify hypothesis preservation and strict decrease for every allowed move.
